<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR data, the compound shows a para‑disubstituted aromatic ring (two doublets of 2 H each), a methoxy singlet (3 H) typical of an ester OCH₃, and two benzylic CH₂ groups appearing as triplets (2 H each) with the same coupling constant, indicating a –CH₂‑CH₂‑ linkage attached to the aromatic ring and terminating in a carbonyl. This pattern fits a para‑nitro‑substituted phenylpropionate methyl ester. The corresponding SMILES string is:</thought>
<final_answer>O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc(cc1)CC(=O)OC</final_answer>
